qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the oil pan on transmission 4HP-22/4HP-24/A5S 310Z?
What is the screw size and torque for the oil drain plug on A5S 440Z transmission?
What transmission type uses M18x1.5 screws for the oil filler plug?
qa_pairs.answer: A5S 440Z transmission uses M18x1.5 screws for the oil filler plug.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the oil pan on A4S 270R/A4S 310R transmission?
Which component uses M10 screws and what is its torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The oil drain plug uses M10 screws torqued to 16 Nm for all transmission types.
